column1: The 13 buses and how each one is selected

A bus is one directed edge of the machine map. SATURATES AT is the channel value that fills the bus completely; emission is log1p(v)/log1p(ref) scaled by the max rate on PARAMETERS. BOW is how far the path bends off the straight line - its only job is to stop the eight buses meeting at the CPU from collapsing into a star. A bus is selected by its channel: traffic appears on it when and only when that channel moves.
